CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `sessionId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `role` TEXT NOT NULL, `text` TEXT NOT NULL, `correction` TEXT, `providerPayload` TEXT, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`sessionId`) REFERENCES `sessions`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )

indices.name: index_messages_sessionId
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_messages_sessionId` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`sessionId`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`text` TEXT NOT NULL, `correction` TEXT, tokenize=unicode61, content=`messages`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_messages_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `messages` BEGIN DELETE FROM `messages_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_messages_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `messages` BEGIN DELETE FROM `messages_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_messages_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `messages` BEGIN INSERT INTO `messages_fts`(`docid`, `text`, `correction`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`, NEW.`correction`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_messages_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `messages` BEGIN INSERT INTO `messages_fts`(`docid`, `text`, `correction`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`, NEW.`correction`); END
